notes: Compliance A/B for glm-5.3-flash, judge mimo-v2.6-flash, 14 cases x 5 reps, 237 calls, 0 recorded errors. Run produced by runner at commit ebc370b (with the retry-on-transient-failure logic); runner bytes changed at 695021c after the run, so eval-status --check reports STALE by design. Promotion decision (Adrian Tame): promote as-is and document known flaws. Retry-contamination audit (2026-09-25): run had 49 in-place retries (27 compliance + 22 trigger). Three arms are CONFIRMED contaminated - attempt 1's discarded work survived into the recorded session (verified by file mtime falling between arm staging and session start, and by judge-transcribed evidence): (1) sync-docs/prune-not-append rep5 treatment (README.md pre-modified 5.6s before session); (2) log-decision/reverses-existing-decision rep4 control (docs/decision-log.md pre-written 10.5s before session); (3) log-decision/decision-log-append-only rep1 control (attempt 1 created docs/decisions/decision-log.md, attempt 2 answered 'already logged' with files_modified empty). Root cause was fixed in 695021c (arm snapshot restored before every retry). Residual risk: an attempt-1 write later overwritten by attempt 2 is undetectable post-hoc; a behavioral signature scan across all arms ('work already done' + empty files_modified) surfaced 11 suspects, 3 of which are the confirmed arms above, the remaining 8 are legitimate case responses (the conflict case leaves files untouched by design) and clean-run probes. The fix commit also records an 'attempts' field in transcript evidence so future retries are auditable. Judge independence verified: judge (mimo-v2.6-flash) differs from every target; judge sessions inspected across both rounds are read-only (no edit/write tools, bash used only for read-only inspection of A/B evidence).
